description: OpenAI chat completion with one tool call, then an answer, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on spans as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. Token counts are copied from prompt_tokens and completion_tokens. The first span writes cache_read.input_tokens 0 and reasoning_tokens 0. The second span's input is 131 and cache_read.input_tokens is 64. gen_ai.openai.api_base is the public host https://api.openai.com/v1/.
